timing: After the first read-only finalization verified all 90 locked artifacts and reached the continuous summary audit, before a canonical compatible result or any mechanism output.
diagnosis: The exhaustive read-only audit found two dependency-graph coverage defects. Numeric summary paths outside their assigned budget comprised only 206 Liu behavior coherence values. Coherence is a continuous gradient-energy fraction of the antisymmetric margin field, but the path classifier had assigned the 1e-10 same-input gate. Separately, 480 panel/equal-panel CE bootstrap arrays ended in liu_full or liu_global without a trailing slash, so the classifier missed the already registered Liu CE budget. No third continuous metric family exceeded its assigned budget.

repair.ce_draw_paths: Classify metrics by exact slash-delimited path segments rather than substring-with-trailing-slash. generic_full, generic_global, liu_full, and liu_global receive their existing temperature-specific CE budgets at points, draws, panel means, and intervals.
repair.coherence_bound: For each parent subject and full/global Liu route, let x be the 28-element antisymmetric field, let elementwise field budget d_j=(b_forward_j+b_reverse_j)/2, and delta=norm_2(d). Because the gradient projector is orthogonal and coherence q(x)=||P x||^2/||x||^2, require norm_2(x)>delta and use |q(x+e)-q(x)| <= min(1, 4*delta/(norm_2(x)-delta)). Aggregate subject bounds through the exact registered bootstrap weights and quantile max-draw rule; a conservative maximum across frozen units may be used only after computing this formula for every parent subject.
repair.discrete_arrays: Before summaries, explicitly require exact generic signs, learned masks and episode indices plus Liu evidence routes, sampled orders, sampled masks and internal order arrays for full and global routes. Continuous bounds never substitute for this gate.
repair.qualification: Write qualification_v5.json with synthetic orthogonal-projector coherence perturbations, path-segment coverage, and exact discrete-array mismatch rejection.
repair.source_lock: Write baseline_finalize_source_lock_v2.json. Preserve attempt3 and the previous finalizer lock.
repair.execution: Rerun only the read-only finalizer over the unchanged baseline_attempt2_artifact_lock. Checkpoint loading and model replay remain prohibited.
